model:
tff('declare_$i1',type,'fmb_$i_1':$i).
tff('declare_$i2',type,'fmb_$i_2':$i).
tff('declare_$i3',type,'fmb_$i_3':$i).
tff('finite_domain_$i',axiom,
      ! [X:$i] : (
         X = 'fmb_$i_1' | X = 'fmb_$i_2' | X = 'fmb_$i_3'
      ) ).

tff('distinct_domain_$i',axiom,
         'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_2' & 'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_3' & 'fmb_$i_2' != 'fmb_$i_3'
).

tff(declare_w0_0_1,type,w0_0_1:$i).
tff(w0_0_1_definition,axiom,w0_0_1 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_w0_1_0,type,w0_1_0:$i).
tff(w0_1_0_definition,axiom,w0_1_0 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_w1_0_0,type,w1_0_0:$i).
tff(w1_0_0_definition,axiom,w1_0_0 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_w1_0_1,type,w1_0_1:$i).
tff(w1_0_1_definition,axiom,w1_0_1 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_w0_0_0,type,w0_0_0:$i).
tff(w0_0_0_definition,axiom,w0_0_0 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_w0_1_1,type,w0_1_1:$i).
tff(w0_1_1_definition,axiom,w0_1_1 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_w1_1_0,type,w1_1_0:$i).
tff(w1_1_0_definition,axiom,w1_1_0 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_w1_1_1,type,w1_1_1:$i).
tff(w1_1_1_definition,axiom,w1_1_1 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_true_factor,type,true_factor: ($i) > $o).
tff(predicate_true_factor,axiom,
           true_factor('fmb_$i_1')
         & ~true_factor('fmb_$i_2')
         & ~true_factor('fmb_$i_3')

).

tff(declare_mech25,type,mech25: ($i) > $o).
tff(predicate_mech25,axiom,
           mech25('fmb_$i_1')
         & mech25('fmb_$i_2')
         & ~mech25('fmb_$i_3')

).
